states.label: Intact
states.description: Continuous facesheets and an intact core provide the reference for inspection and repair assessment.

states.label: Impact damage
states.description: Local indentation or cracking accompanies core crushing. Internal damage may be difficult to see and requires nondestructive inspection.

states.label: Perforation
states.description: A hole through the upper facesheet and core interrupts structural integrity and the absorbing layer.

states.label: Repaired
states.description: Core replacement, adhesive film, repair plies, and curing restore the local sandwich geometry.
